name: Ascii Side View — 3D rotation from front to side
description: Spatial reasoning benchmark: each episode is a different 3D object. The agent receives a front-view ASCII projection plus a description and must output the side view after 90° rotation. Step reward = IoU improvement minus penalties for illegal characters and wrong grid dimensions.

binding_vow.description: Each episode samples a different object (deterministic by seed). Exactly 7 refinement steps per episode. Step reward = max(0, IoU − prev_IoU) − penalties. Terminal final_iou in info.

observation_space.description: { task, description, front_view, output_rules, example, steps_left, optional previous_iou/best_iou/previous_submission/feedback }

action_space.description: STRICT: side-view ASCII grid ONLY. Each line must use ONLY # (solid) and . (empty). Do NOT include any explanation, reasoning, labels, or markdown. Grid dimensions must match the expected canvas size.

reward.description: Per-step: IoU gain vs previous submission minus penalties (illegal chars: 0.02 each up to 0.25; wrong row/col count: 0.12). Episode total = sum of step rewards. Terminal final_iou reported in info.
